assessment.rationale: No fleet of turbines has AI blade control that adapts in real time to every gust, and the Main KPI of 1,000,000 turbines upgraded is not met (it exceeds today's global turbine count, so it implies new and retrofitted turbines). Active trailing-edge flaps and morphing blades remain field and rig tests (DTU INDUFLAP on a 100 kW turbine, Sandia SMART rotor, https://www.windpower-international.com/analysis/more-than-a-flap-in-the-wind-smart-blade-control-and-flap-systems-4623534/; Limerick outdoor rig, https://pure.ul.ie/en/publications/field-testing-of-morphing-flaps-on-a-wind-turbine-blade-using-an-/). AI pitch-control retrofits are patents and single-turbine studies without a fleet count (https://www.windsystemsmag.com/the-application-of-ai-across-wind-energy/). Honest limit: individual pitch control is already in many commercial turbines, and open controllers implement IPC and lidar feedforward (NREL ROSCO, https://rosco.readthedocs.io/; Russell et al. 2024, up to 12% load gain in simulation, https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/88862). Tasks that re-implement IPC or lidar feedforward are not new; work must target unsolved gust-resolved blade actuation, its reliability, or field-validated learned control with its own prior-art basis.

additionalSearches.query: real-time adaptive blade control wind turbine gusts morphing trailing edge flaps field test commercial
additionalSearches.finding: Trailing-edge flaps field-tested by DTU (100 kW) and Sandia; production 'a few years away'; no commercial flap fleet found.

additionalSearches.query: ROSCO open source wind turbine controller individual pitch control lidar feedforward
additionalSearches.finding: ROSCO open reference controller supports individual pitch control and lidar-assisted feedforward; simulation-validated prior art.

additionalSearches.query: LIDAR-assisted feedforward individual pitch control 15 MW floating turbine
additionalSearches.finding: Russell et al. 2024: lidar feedforward IPC gives up to 12% gains over feedforward collective pitch in OpenFAST simulation; built in ROSCO.

additionalSearches.query: AI machine learning wind turbine pitch control retrofit fleet upgrade number of turbines 2026
additionalSearches.finding: AI pitch control appears as patents, analytics software and single-turbine studies; no fleet-scale count of AI blade-control retrofits found.

additionalSearches.query: field testing morphing flaps wind turbine blade outdoor rotating rig
additionalSearches.finding: 2019 morphing-flap control demonstrated on a scaled outdoor rotating rig; research stage.
